_README: HAND-MAINTAINED roster additions. New players don't exist in the APA API until they've
played and been entered, so a captain who knows a new name is coming can't see them in the
matchup until then. This file injects known players into a team's roster during the build.
New APA players start as Skill Level 3. They have no match history, so the matchup engine
scores them purely on the SL3-vs-SL baseline (low confidence) — which is exactly right for
an unrated player. Once they show up in a real API pull, drop them from here so their real
record takes over. `new:true` just flags them in the UI as unrated.
Keyed by APA team id. mid is a synthetic 'new-…' string so nothing collides with a real
member id; if you later learn their real mid, delete the entry (the pull will carry them).
